newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market closes on buying mood.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market closes on buying mood.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market rose on Tuesday, helped by buying pressure coming mainly from foreign investors.
Operators said they expected fresh gains for high-caps during trading this week. They said investors would target on oil refineries and cement makers.
Advancing issues beat decliners 146 to 77, while 321 stayed flat.
All three independent indices, computed by brokerage houses on the basis of average prices and market capitalisation, gained on Tuesday from the previous session.
The VAB-RA all-share index went up by 3.5 percent to 5,020.6 points, BIG-OTC rose by 3.32 percent to 3,958.03 and CAS-RQ climbed 3.3 percent to 902 points.
Oil refinery Arpechim, one of the investors' preferred listings gained 1,500 lei to close at 37,500, while the Petrobrazi refinery firmed at 46,500, up 5,000 lei.
Cement maker Romcim was one of the main gainers, closing 14,000 up to 110,000 lei, under buying pressure. Moldocim, another cement maker, closed 3,000 lei stronger at 42,500.
Tuesday's turnover rose to 27.7 billion from 21.81 billion previously, with 5.16 million shares changing hands.
The VAB-RA index is displayed on VANGUARD and CAS-RQ on CASE02.
